visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman is seated in a hair salon chair. Her hair is covered in a thick grey paste and foils, and small white patches are taped over her eyebrows. She is wearing a black salon cape and leaning her head on her hand with a bored expression. The background is a brightly lit, professional hair salon with multiple styling stations and mirrors. (2) The camera moves closer and the woman suddenly reacts, making a playful 'startled' pose with her hands curled near her face and a wide smile. The lighting remains bright and even. (3) She is seen holding a clear plastic container and eating food with wooden chopsticks while still in her hair treatment. A hand enters the frame and pours a clear liquid from a green wine bottle into a white paper cup held by the woman. (4) A quick transition shows a hand flipping through a teal color swatch folder containing many circular hair dye samples. (5) The woman sits under a large, black spherical hair steamer dome which emits a red glow from the inside. A cartoon clock graphic appears at the bottom. She adjusts her hands and looks at the camera. (6) She now has a black towel wrapped tightly around her head, indicating she has had her hair washed. She takes a sip from the paper cup. (7) The final reveal shows the woman with styled, shoulder-length brown hair. She is wearing a blue t-shirt and a floral skirt. She makes various cute poses for the camera, touching her face and smiling brightly. (8) In the final shot, she poses with the female hairstylist who is holding the wine bottle above their heads in a celebratory gesture.

The vocal delivery is playful and exaggerated. (2) A sharp rustling sound of plastic occurs as the woman handles food containers. The voices interact in a conversational but excited manner, with frequent rising intonations. (3) A distinct SFX of a clock ticking with high-frequency percussive clicks is heard, accompanied by a slight ducking of the BGM volume. (4) The sound of liquid pouring creates a short-duration splashing texture. A celebratory 'whoosh' transition effect plays during a scene change. (5) The final phase features a swell in BGM volume and energy, with more rhythmic speech and joyful vocal inflections as the transformation is revealed. The harmonic clarity is high with no distortion.
